titles.title: Social Security 2100 Act
Social Security 2100 Act
To protect our Social Security system and improve benefits for current and future generations.

action.text: Referred to the Committee on Ways and Means, and in addition to the Committees on Education and Workforce, and Energy and Commerce, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.
